adaptation.safe_rect: Use device usable safe area first. Fit the 1100x780 logical canvas with uniform s=min(safe_width/1100,safe_height/780); center within safe_rect. Extra width/height is decorative margin, not a larger physics arena.
adaptation.minimum_hit_target: Each control has48x48 reference logical hit area. On actual device require >=44 UI points; if fitting makes controls smaller, raise control-layer physical UI scale and reflow strip into two rows in available margin, without changing stage or collision geometry. This adaptation must be device-tested by point-point.
adaptation.pixel_sampling: nearest, mipmaps off for UI glyphs, integer icon scaling where possible; avoid stretching icons. Nine-slice panels may stretch only center/edges according to margins.
adaptation.game_world: Arena remains700x600 physics units; visual world-to-canvas transform=(200,90)+world_position at reference size; multiply both axes by the same viewport scale. No physics or collision changes are implied.
adaptation.text: No text or values baked in production textures. Default current HP, cloud seconds, unbounded stored damage, positiveCD values and1×/2×/3× only. Names, seed/time, maxHP/status explanations are on-demand info. Actual important event labels may be transient. Review caption lives outside1100×780 game canvas.
adaptation.orientation: Landscape only; no portrait layout included.
adaptation.character_guard: Physics floor remains x200..900. Side panels end at170 and start930, leaving30px visual overflow per side.96x96 art body origin48,56 can project outside the physics circle; do not clip character/knife to700x600 floor, and render decorative rails before characters. Header ends at56; topmost checked character pixel starts64 at upper wall. Bottom feet reach690; controls start706.

visible_text_policy.info_details: Ninth icon-only control, UI proposal not yet implemented. Expand seed/time/maxHP, skill/status names, seconds units and explanations on demand. Keep the original functions accessible; no permanent prose on canvas.

visible_text_policy.formatting: HP current value only by default; bar still uses health/max_health. Countdown/CD are seconds; no permanent unit letter in sample. CD0 hides numeric and uses ready/busy state. Stored damage has no maximum bar.
visible_text_policy.count_method: Count exact text values emitted by source/build_preview.py; exclude whitespace, outside review caption and contact-sheet inspection labels; no OCR; live numbers may have different lengths.
